chunks.text:
SPEAKER_01: Hey Eric, how are you doing?
SPEAKER_01: Very good, very good, thank you.
SPEAKER_00: Nice catching up again.
SPEAKER_01: Yeah, we haven't talked in a while.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, I was wondering, surprised that we're catching up via this meeting.
SPEAKER_01: Yeah, I think it's a very good and easy way to do it.
SPEAKER_01: So tell me a bit what has been up in the past years.
SPEAKER_01: Do you still enjoy biking?
SPEAKER_00: Yes, actually I have a trip planned with a few friends in a week and a bit.
SPEAKER_00: And we are going through the south of Argentina.
SPEAKER_00: I am wondering how good I'll be able to keep up with the rest.
SPEAKER_01: Yeah, excited.
SPEAKER_01: I know them so I know that they go pretty hard, but they should be a bit more tired.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, hopefully.
SPEAKER_01: Maybe that's on your side.
SPEAKER_01: And do you do a lot of camping every day or hostels as well?
SPEAKER_00: We plan on doing camping I think.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, because it's a pretty unpopulated area.

SPEAKER_00: So I'm not really sure if we'll have the opportunity.
SPEAKER_00: We go through a couple cities though.
SPEAKER_00: So maybe we will be able to.
SPEAKER_00: Dribbing a bed every now and then.
SPEAKER_01: Yeah, maybe doing that and have a hot nice meal.
SPEAKER_01: Well, but I think you can, you take something to cook, right?
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, we're taking those like fossilized packages that you have to just throw in water and you have dinner in 10 minutes.
SPEAKER_01: Ah, that's good.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, very practical.
SPEAKER_01: Yeah, but in terms of weight, I mean, are those the ones that you have to throw hot water in or you just put everything in the hot water?
SPEAKER_00: No, you throw hot water in I think.
SPEAKER_01: Ah, yeah, because otherwise it's very heavy.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
SPEAKER_01: And it's very good.
SPEAKER_01: It's very good.
SPEAKER_01: Okay, I hope you enjoy your trip.
SPEAKER_01: And let's catch up back sooner, sorry later when you come back.
SPEAKER_00: For sure.
SPEAKER_00: Yeah, hope to see you again soon.

SPEAKER_01: Likewise, have a good one.
SPEAKER_00: You too.
SPEAKER_00: Thanks.
